name: inventory_movements.inventory_movements_sign_check
definition: CHECK ((((reason)::text = 'ADJUSTMENT'::text) OR (((reason)::text = ANY (ARRAY['RESTOCK'::text, 'RETURN'::text])) AND (quantity_delta > 0)) OR (((reason)::text = 'SALE'::text) AND (quantity_delta < 0))))

name: shipments.shipments_dates_check
definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'PENDING'::text) AND (shipped_at IS NULL) AND (delivered_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'SHIPPED'::text) AND (shipped_at IS NOT NULL) AND (delivered_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'DELIVERED'::text) AND (shipped_at IS NOT NULL) AND (delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AND (delivered_at >= shipped_at))))
